SLOW TRAIL

One open road. No timer. No finish line.

Loading the trail…

21 vehicles · 9 camps · 16 sights · day, night & four seasons

Vibe coded & designed by Ali Sherin

Release history
Version 3.1.0
  • Day trip (new default): the sun rises as you set off and the light moves through morning, midday, afternoon and sunset into night in about ten minutes
  • At each part of the day the best place to be is suggested, with a route
  • Stargazer Hill: a spot for watching the stars, with shooting stars at night
  • New cheat SUPERMOON: a huge moon over the sea with its path of light on the water; if hills hide it you are guided to a good viewpoint
  • Autumn is the default season
Version 3.0.0
  • Gentler nose-up on launch and nose-dive under braking (half as much)
Version 2.9.9
  • Fix: cars were invisible
Version 2.9.8
  • A wooden marina pier on the south bay with rowboats and a new lighthouse
  • A life raft drifting in the bay and rowboats at the lakes
  • Two wooden footbridges over the river you can drive across
  • The neighbouring island has a proper lighthouse too
Version 2.9.7
  • The menu camera circles the car more slowly
Version 2.9.6
  • Detailed gulls and darker birds with real wings that flap, fold and glide
  • Street cars struggle up steep slopes and bounce about on rough ground; 4x4s, trucks and the quad climb easily and crawl over rocks
  • Wheels ride over loose stones and rocks, low cars scrape on them
  • The body squats when you launch and dives when you brake
  • New sounds for hitting rocks and trees, scraping past things and hard landings
Version 2.9.5
  • The sea comes alive: a cruise ferry sails round the island, plus a superyacht, sailboats, a police boat and inflatables with foaming wakes and lights at night
  • Open ocean to the south-west and a neighbouring island with a town and lighthouse to the north-west, instead of mountains all round
  • No more green dots in the headlight glow
  • Wheels no longer poke up through the bodywork
  • Cars fall harder when they leave the ground
Version 2.9.4
  • Real elephants, giraffes with a true reticulated coat, and wild horses that walk and gallop
  • FIRE: much bigger exhaust flames, smoke and explosive bangs
  • FIREWORKS: real display shells - peony, chrysanthemum, willow, kamuro, palm, crossette, strobe, crackle, saturn, multi-break and more
  • New cheats: GALAXY (a coloured galaxy fills the night sky) and LISTALL (pick any cheat from a list)
  • Reeds by lakes and the sea sway and bend as you drive through
  • REV now sits on top of BRAKE
Version 2.9.3
  • Real helicopter model with spinning rotors
  • New cheats: FIREWORKS (at night) and FIRE (exhaust flames and bangs)
  • FUN cheat removed
Version 2.9.2
  • FUN beach day with realistic swimmers and sunbathers
  • Fixes for the cheats
Version 2.9.1
  • Cheat codes in Menu → World: TURBO, MOON, GHOST, BIGBOY, DRIFT, TELEPORT, NOCLIP, HELICOPTER, FUN, TIMEWARP, ALLSEEN, STORM, CLEAR
Version 2.9.0
  • More natural, softer colours on trees, grass and ground
  • Darker shadows and real blacks
  • Deeper green grass by day
  • The map now shows the jungle
Version 2.8.9
  • No more dark outlines around trees
  • Bright whites keep their detail instead of clipping
  • Trees and rocks look darker when you face the sun
Version 2.8.8
  • Real oaks up close: trunk, branches and a round leafy crown
  • Trees and grass use simpler detail sooner on lower graphics settings
  • Smooth fade between tree detail levels
  • Grass thins out gently with distance
  • New Haze slider: a soft dreamy haze over the landscape
Version 2.8.7
  • Trees no longer look dotty as they come closer
  • Grass reaches much further and fades softly into the distance
Version 2.8.6
  • Faster forests: lighter grass, trees and far mountains
  • Sharper picture: auto resolution never drops below 85%
  • Richer colours with gentle colour grading
  • Car paint and glass reflect the sky
Version 2.8.5
  • Distance focus off by default on phones (faster)
  • Readout shows how smooth frames are (p95)
Version 2.8.4
  • Much lighter grass and tree shadows
  • Low and Medium graphics are now really lighter
  • Automatic resolution only lowers when it actually helps
  • Fewer objects drawn: animals and clouds
Version 2.8.3
  • Automatic resolution keeps the frame rate smooth
  • Detailed performance readout (Options → Display → FPS)
Version 2.8.2
  • Grass reaches far into the distance and blends into full grass as you get close
  • Deeper turbo sound
  • Recovers by itself if the screen ever stops drawing
  • Clean poster on the loading screen, no square flash on buttons
  • Lighter shadows on High at resolution 1.5 and above
  • Gentler, slower tree sway
Version 2.8.1
  • Trees, bushes, rocks and grass dissolve in instead of popping up
  • Shadows fade out at the edge instead of appearing suddenly
  • Grass bends and flattens under the car; trees and bushes shake as you brush past
  • Turbo whistle and blow-off on the sports cars
  • Waterfall cliff rebuilt as a real rock wall
Version 2.8.0
  • Trees sway in the wind and their leaves flutter
  • Autopilot steers round rocks and trees, and backs off to try the other side if it gets stuck
Version 2.7.9
  • Always landscape: the loading screen turns with the game, and phones lock to landscape on start
Version 2.7.8
  • Autumn leaves fall around the trees, not across the camera
  • Chase camera moves to keep the car in sight behind trees and cliffs
  • Loading screen starts only from the TAP TO START button
  • Credits and this release history
Version 2.7.7
  • Real desert mesas with layered cliffs and rubble slopes
  • Rugged far mountains with crags, gullies and rough rock texture
  • New lighthouse with a railed walkway and glass lantern room
  • Detailed keeper's cottage
  • Softer lighthouse beam
Version 2.7.6
  • Far mesas shaded as red rock
Version 2.7.5
  • Rigged deer, stags, foxes and wolves that walk, gallop and graze
  • All animals speed up, turn and stop smoothly
Version 2.7.4
  • The whole car collides with rocks, not just its middle
  • Warm brown far mountains
Version 2.7.3
  • Tundra wheels back on the road
Version 2.7.2
  • Pebble wheels run straight
Version 2.7.1
  • Mule's tailgate and spare cover take the paint

  • Poster loading screen
  • Golden-hour sunset lighting
